g.text: Notifications: Hermod fans alerts out to Discord by tag
Producers POST one JSON shape. Severity colours the message; the tag picks the channel.
routes by tag, never by severity
every routed URL has an explicit tag
canary and non-prod are capped here
routine success is a log line,
webhook URL per tag + config key
Sources: docs/services/notifications.md. Hermod is an LXC, not a pod, so alerts about K3s being down still fire.
